METHODOLOGY // WORKFLOW

HOW WE SHIP

A battle-tested 7-stage engineering methodology designed to deliver resilient products on schedule.

STEP 01

DISCOVER

Understand requirements and business goals.

We begin by aligning on your product objectives, core audience, functional scope, technical constraints, and measurable success criteria.

STEP 02

PLAN

Define features, architecture and development approach.

Drafting data schemas, system boundaries, technology stacks, milestone timelines, and component breakdowns for efficient execution.

STEP 03

DESIGN

Create responsive and user-friendly interfaces.

Prototyping intuitive UI layouts, visual hierarchy, mobile viewport responsiveness, and clean interactive states.

STEP 04

DEVELOP

Build frontend, backend and integrations.

Writing clean, typed, modular code with reusable components, robust state handling, REST API services, and responsive styles.

STEP 05

TEST

Check functionality, responsiveness, APIs and edge cases.

Rigorous cross-device testing, API verification with Postman, automated UI test routines, and edge-case validation to prevent defects.

STEP 06

DEPLOY

Prepare the project for production.

Configuring domain DNS, production environments (Vercel, AWS, etc.), performance caching, security headers, and SEO metadata.

STEP 07

SUPPORT

Improve and maintain the product when required.

Continuous updates, feature extensions, performance optimization, and rapid bug resolution as your product scales.
